title: Wind
body:
Syntax: (no command of its own -- a personal trait revealed by channeling a Chakra Paper, see 'help channel')

Description: One of the five chakra natures (see 'help elements'). Wind Blade Jutsu (Ninjutsu, level 20) requires Wind to cast at all, and carries a real chance to knock the target Off Balance -- steadily draining their own stamina each round for a few rounds.

Boosted in forests and deserts. Weakened in the mountains.

Date: 2026-08-26

Second nature choices at level 25:
Wind + Fire: Scorch Release (help scorch release)
Wind + Water: Ice Release (help ice release)
Wind + Earth: Magnet Release (help magnet release)
Wind + Lightning: Tempest Release (help tempest release)
